header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.arabic_text: أَضْلَاعُهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ بِأَصَابِعِهِ فَأَدْخَلَ بَعْضَهَا فِي جَوْفِ بَعْضٍ قَالَ: وَيُقَيِّضُ اللهُ لَهُ سَبْعِينَ تِنِّيناً لَوْ أَنَّ وَاحِدًا مِنْهَا نَفَخَ فِي اْلاَرْضِ مَا أَنْبَتَتْ شَيْئاً مَا بَقِيَتِ الدُّنْيَا فَيَنْهَشْنَهُ وَيَخْدِشْنَهُ حَتَّي يُقْضَي بِهِ إِلَي الْحِسَابِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّمَا الْقَبْرُ رَوْضَةٌ مِّنْ رِّيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ أَوْ حُفْرَةٌ مِنْ حُفَرِ النَّارِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب باب حديث اكثروا ذكر هاذم اللذات، رقم:٢٤٦٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Sa'id (RA) narrates, “Once, when the Prophet ﷺ came for Salah, he saw some of the people laughing so that their teeth showed. The Prophet ﷺ said, “If you remembered often death, which cuts off pleasures, this state in which I see you would not come about.’ “So remember very often death, which cuts off pleasures, for every day the grave keeps saying, “I am the house of dread, I am the house of loneliness. I am the house of dust, I am the house of worms and insects.’ When a believing servant is buried in the grave, the grave says to him, “Welcome! It is very good that you have come here; of all those who walked upon me, you were the most beloved to me. Today you have come to me; you will see my finest hospitality!’ and saying this, the grave becomes wide as far as the deceased's sight reaches, and for that deceased a door is opened towards Jannah. When a sinner or a kafir is placed in the grave, it says, “May your coming be an evil coming’, your coming has turned out very evil. Of all those who walked upon my back, you were the most hateful to me; today you have been handed over to me.
